messages:
Riley: Quick heads-up 1 HelixAI (preview cohort) asked to defer full rollout due to finance review but theyd like a limited "stakeholder demo" path to keep execs engaged. Can we offer a sandbox + 30m enablement + a micro-survey?
Akira: Yep. What product surface are we demoing? If it's convo + rerank we should lock a 45m session; if embeddings-only 250m is fine.
Marta (HelixAI): Convo + rerank originally. Finance wants a short ROI note + a 2-week demo window. Also legal requested a sample DPA redline.
Devon: We can do 2-week sandbox hosted in US-east with retention 7d and token cap $1,000. I'll provision once we confirm region. Command Ill run: ```rb prov sandbox --org helix-ai --env demo --region us-east-1 --model redwood-convo-v1 --tokens 25000 --timebox 14d```
Riley: Great. @Marta can you confirm up to 6 demo attendees and who will present from your side? Also please share any KPI they want measured during the demo.
Marta (HelixAI): Presenters: CTO + product lead + procurement rep. KPI: internal stakeholder sentiment + demo acceptance (qual), and theyd like to capture a metric for decision lead time improvement.
Clara: For the ROI note, propose: expected time-savings on support triage based on reranker, and a sample cost estimate for early production. I can draft a 1-page ROI + exec slide.
Akira: I'll assemble a minimal DPA redline + security FAQ. Devon please ensure sandbox is in US-east and that logs are disabled for the demo data.
Devon: On it. ETA ~2h. Will post creds and secure link here when done.
NotesBot: Reminder: please tag the account with 'finance_review' and set health to at-risk until PO (Gainsight).
Marta (HelixAI): Thanks 44d we'll share attendee names by EOD. Also, can CS run a short pre-demo sample evaluation so we have example outputs for the exec slide?
Riley: Yes 1 will export a 3-sample prompt set and p50/p95 latency to the shared drive. Also will create a micro-survey (3 Qs) to run post-demo and wire responses to the feedback board.
Devon: Sandbox helix-ai-demo created by devon at 1998765430 (region us-east-1, model redwood-convo-v1, token_cap 25000, timebox 14d). Link sent via secure share.
Clara: Draft ROI slide uploaded: https://redwood.internal/cs/helixai/roi-1pager. Please review and comment.
Akira: DPA redline uploaded to handoff doc. Also pinging legal for a quick OK on the sample clause.
Marta (HelixAI): Received creds, thanks. We'll confirm attendees and look forward to the 30/45m demo.
Riley: TL;DR next steps: 1) Confirm attendees (Marta) 2) ROI slide review (Clara) 3) DPA redline check (Akira/legal) 4) Pre-demo sample outputs (Riley) 5) Post-demo micro-survey + feedback capture (Riley). I'll follow up in #customer-success tomorrow AM with status. :thumbsup:
